anchor_value: schedule fair value column is USD; euro symbol is in Par/Shares column

culprit_citations.quoted_text: First Lien Secured Debt - Corporate Bond | 5.00 % | 2/15/2027 | EUR | 1,000 | 1,072 | 1,003 | (3)(8)(9)

findings.detail: The source euro symbol belongs to Par/Shares, while Cost and Fair Value roll into dollar-denominated schedule totals; fair_value_currency was populated as U_EUR.

rationale: FX02 is a real data error. The source row shows EUR only in the Par/Shares currency position, followed by cost 1,072 and fair value 1,003 in the Cost/Fair Value columns. The same industry block totals Cost and Fair Value with dollar signs, so carrying U_EUR into fair_value_currency reflects a source-column/unit assignment error, not a valid non-USD fair value.
